gomad: add the scheduled determinism soak gate

gomadtool soak runs the soak.json selection (the functional smoke suites
and the guarded-mode frontend probe, seeds 11 and 17) in gomad qualify
batches of 32 fresh repetitions with diagnostics on, under two busy host
threads. Each clean batch is compared with its cohort baseline (workload,
seed, platform, execution identity) in a ledger carried between scheduled
runs; a changed toolchain identity starts a new cohort. Overflow, target
failure, and infrastructure failure are reported apart from divergence,
and a divergence retains both diagnostic traces and the differ output.
Rounds past the minimum two run only while the measured round cost fits
the budget. gomad3.yml gains scheduled darwin/arm64 (strict) and
linux/amd64 (informational while fn-105 D12 is open) soak jobs.
